test_title: PYST 24 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

Their first __**date**__ was at an art exhibition.

options.text: I need to check the expiry date on this milk carton.
They agreed to go on a second date after their coffee meeting.
He invited her to a dinner date at his favorite restaurant.
The movie was a great choice for a first date.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"date"** in the context of the question refers to a romantic meeting or social outing. (डेट / मुलाकात)
 
 
• **Example:** They enjoyed their first date at the coffee shop.
 

 
• The word **"date"** in Option 1 refers to a specific day or time when something is scheduled or occurs. (तिथि)
 
 
• **Example:** The expiry date on the food package is clearly printed.
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer contains a homonym of the word "date" as it has a different meaning in Option 1.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** They agreed to go on a second date after their coffee meeting. (डेट / मुलाकात) 
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to plan their next date at a park.
 
 

 
• **Option 3:** He invited her to a dinner date at his favorite restaurant. (डेट / मुलाकात)
 
 
• **Example:** Their dinner date was filled with laughter and good food.
 
 

 
• **Option 4:** The movie was a great choice for a first date. (डेट / मुलाकात)
 
 
• **Example:** Watching a romantic movie on their first date was a memorable experience.
 
 

37:T723,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
